'''Gungan sandals''' were a type of footwear among the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Gungan leader [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] wore such sandals.
